templates.title: Word Templates (docx4j)
templates.purpose: Generates the official letters/borang (.docx): template file + CC tags filled by populator methods, then saved to DMS.

reports.title: Jasper Reports (jrxml)
reports.purpose: Generates PDF reports (Borang 4Ae/L1e, laporan): .jrxml layouts filled from SQL-in-jrxml or a Java datasource.

flowable.title: Flowable / BPMN engine
flowable.purpose: The workflow engine: BPMN diagrams define urusan step order; listeners/delegates connect engine events to etanah code.

tugasan.title: Tugasan lifecycle (handoff)
tugasan.purpose: Passing one Tugasan to the next: task rows (umm_a_tgsn), role assignment, the dashboard inbox that opens each step.

screens.title: Tugasan screens (JSF forms + composites)
screens.purpose: The per-step screens officers use: Mlk*Form backing beans, .xhtml composites, and the Helper classes that populate them.

emohon.title: AWAM portal (e-Mohon)
emohon.purpose: The public portal: applicant creates a permohonan (umm_p_* pra rows) which is copied into staff-side umm_a_* rows at intake.

spoc.title: SPOC / HASIL (counter + payment)
spoc.purpose: Perserahan Kaunter intake and payment: the SECOND entry route whose save code differs from the portal (two-entry-route family).

dokumen.title: Dokumen & DMS (upload / keluaran)
dokumen.purpose: File upload and generated-document storage: two-phase upload into the separate etanah-dms app; slot rows + Document pointer rows.

persistence.title: Entities & persistence (Hibernate/JPA)
persistence.purpose: The data layer: @Entity classes (etanah-domain JAR) mapped to tables via prefix constants; repositories run the queries.

peranan.title: Peranan & capaian (roles/security)
peranan.purpose: Who may hold which tugasan: pengguna/peranan tables, role override on task assignment, capaian screens.

migration.title: Migration (legacy data)
migration.purpose: Legacy register imports (MIGRATOR_* rows) and the migrasi screens; source of many 'weird old data' tickets.

config.title: Config subsystems (*.config.json)
config.purpose: Declarative wiring: which tugasan shows which panels/actions/templates — behaviour changed by editing JSON, not Java.

other-module.title: Other modules (dft/str/amb/pks/...)
other-module.purpose: Tables owned by modules outside the 12 pelupusan-side feature groups.

unassigned.title: Unassigned (housekeeping)
unassigned.purpose: md_/tkr_/tmp_/rpt_ etc. — no feature claimed them; honest bucket.
